"We modeled headcount growth and we blow through the per-seat threshold by Q2, so the step-down pricing matters a lot."

No further context from that call is in the data, so how the conversation resolved is not confirmed here.

The opp is currently in negotiation (SFDC, CoreFlow - Enterprise 2026, $142K, close date 2026-09-11), so this context sits inside an active deal.

_Account POV. Drawing the org and overlaying our engagement._

Pulling the account POV for CoreFlow.

This is an open opportunity: CoreFlow - Enterprise 2026, stage negotiation, $142K, close date 2026-09-11 (SFDC).

Engagement is concentrated heavily in Lifecycle Marketing and Marketing Ops. Chris Jones (Head of Lifecycle Marketing, flagged as recently hired) is the champion and has appeared on all three recorded calls: Discovery on 2026-06-17, Pricing Review on 2026-06-22, and QBR on 2026-06-24 (Gong). Robert Smith (CMO, conf 0.85) joined the Discovery call. Nicole Anderson (Marketing Ops Specialist) appeared on both the Discovery and QBR calls. Stephanie Clark (Marketing Ops Manager) joined the Pricing Review. Daniel Davis carries the same Head of Lifecycle Marketing title as Chris Jones, which may indicate a duplicate record or a restructure; worth verifying before the next call.

No Engineering or Finance voices have appeared on any call. Victor Osei (VP Engineering, conf 0.90) and Priya Raman (VP Finance, conf 0.55) are mapped in the org but have no recorded engagement. Raman's confidence is low and should be treated as unverified.

Tom Bradley (Staff Engineer, conf 0.45) is the lowest-confidence row in the data and likely needs verification before use.

There is an open Director of Lifecycle Marketing role (LinkedIn, 2026-07-24, conf 0.80), posted while Chris Jones is already in a Head of Lifecycle Marketing position. One read is that the team is expanding above or alongside the current function; another is that Jones's role may shift. No source in the data resolves that.

The EngagementAdapter returned no rows, so email or web-session-level attribution to specific contacts is not available.

_Scanning your accounts._

Every account in the data carries has_open_opp=true, so none of these are outbound targets. What follows is a signal rundown across open opportunities, ranked by signal recency and count, for reps working active cycles.

---

NovaGrid (manufacturing, 2,025 employees, opp: NovaGrid - Expansion 2026, stage qualification, close 2026-12-03)

Two signals in four days. A contact visited /case-studies four times in the last seven days, with a 247-second session on the most recent visit (gtm-os.internal/analytics/sessions/271bd402-14e, 2026-08-01). That page pattern may indicate someone internally building a business case or comparing outcomes, worth noting given the opp is still in qualification. Separately, a $5M Series C led by a16z was announced 2026-07-29 (crunchbase.com/organization/novacomp/funding_rounds). No champion name in the data.

---

FuseWorks (manufacturing, 531 employees, opp: FuseWorks - Renewal 2026, stage prospecting, close 2027-01-24)

Two signals in seven days. A Director of Lifecycle Marketing opening was posted on LinkedIn 2026-08-01 (linkedin.com/jobs/view/7c502eb0), located in Scotland, GB. A $30M Seed round led by Accel was announced 2026-07-25 (crunchbase.com/organization/fuseworks/funding_rounds). A $30M seed is unusually large, so growth pressure on sending infrastructure is likely elevated. A new lifecycle leader hire, if it closes, usually precedes a sending audit in the new leader's first quarter. No champion on file in the data.

---

CipherWorks (healthcare, 3,235 employees, opps: Enterprise and Strategic both at prospecting, Pilot at proposal stage close 2026-09-27)

One signal detected 2026-07-30. A Head of Lifecycle Marketing opening posted on LinkedIn (linkedin.com/jobs/view/78415124), located in Bavaria, DE. With a Pilot opp already at proposal and close-dated 2026-09-27, the lifecycle hire signal may indicate team-building ahead of a broader rollout. No champion name in the data; no Gong or Gmail data present.

---

CoreFlow (finance, 1,531 employees, opp: CoreFlow - Enterprise 2026, stage negotiation, close 2026-09-11)

Two funding signals, though the data shows conflicting amounts: $15M Series C detected 2026-07-30 and $100M Series C detected 2026-07-28, both attributed to Crunchbase at the same URL (crunchbase.com/organization/corepay/funding_rounds), leads a16z and Accel respectively. The amounts and investors differ across the two rows, so worth verifying which is accurate before using either figure. The opp is in negotiation with a close date of 2026-09-11, and CoreFlow is also a named reference customer (deliverly.com/case-studies/coreflow).

---

PeakForce (healthcare, 2,015 employees, opps: Pilot at prospecting close 2026-11-07, Renewal at negotiation close 2026-09-04)

One signal detected 2026-07-28. A contact visited /pricing five times in the last seven days, with a 110-second session (gtm-os.internal/analytics/sessions/6ebcaf3c-a88). The visit count is high but the session duration is short, so whether that reflects active pricing comparison or a quick check is unclear. Renewal opp closes 2026-09-04.
